# S1.23 — Land the C0 approvals and extension-trust slices: `R-2.8.7⁰` Π floors + `UnattendedPolicy = deny` + never-auto set + `ApprovalRequest`/`ApprovalResponse` + durable `pending` + exact-hash run leases; `R-2.8.5⁰` `ExtensionRecord`/`ExtensionTrustRecord` + declared sources + resolve pins + `default_text_authority`

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.7 (`R-2.8.7⁰`) · §5g.5 (`R-2.8.5⁰`) ·
ADR-0063…0065 · ADR-0069…0071 · CF-152 · I-P5/I-P6
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/027_S1.23__approvals-and-extension-trust-slices.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.7⁰**, **R-2.8.5⁰**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.22` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all verification is the `cargo` suites)

## Summary
The C0/Stage-1 halves of approvals & escalation and extension supply-chain
trust land: the typed approval records and mechanics, the durable
owed-decision row with the ephemeral prompt rendering, exact-hash run
leases, the replayable mediation fold, the extension records with their
declared-source/pin/authority rules, and the assembly `extensions` member
with resolve-time pinning through the registry.

### Approvals (R-2.8.7⁰)
- **`hh-monitor::approval`** (new module): `PermissionRequest`,
  `ApprovalRequest`, `ApprovalOption`, `ApprovalResponse`, `Explanation`,
  `ApprovalLease`/`LeaseBasis`, `EscalationInput`/`EscalationDecision`/
  `ReviewerRef`, `PendingTerminal` — strict canonical codecs throughout.
  `request_approval`/`respond`/`withdraw` mechanics: exactly one decision
  per `permission_id` (duplicate `respond` returns the recorded decision);
  identical pending `(capability_ref, args_canonical_hash)` asks coalesce
  (deterministic `mint_permission_id`); `irreversible`/`UNKNOWN` never
  coalesce — the effect id salts the mint (`never_auto`); batch allow = N
  endorsements; `human(principal)`/`policy_rule` are the only legitimate
  endorser bases (`IllegitimateEndorsement` otherwise);
  `timed_out`/`cancelled`/`abort` are refusals, never `unknown`.
- **Π floors**: `UnattendedPolicy = deny` verified; the never-auto set
  (`secret_access`, `spend`, `permission_request`, `irreversible ∧
  external`) explicit as `floor_verdict`/`pi_8`; exact-hash leases mint at
  `scope = run` (`key = H(capability_ref ∥ args_canonical_hash ∥ scope ∥
  policy_fingerprint)` — a policy change revokes by construction);
  `irreversible` leases require `max_uses`.
- **Ledger rows**: `security.permission.pending` audit-grade
  (`PENDING_FIELDS`) — the durable owed-decision record;
  `security.permission.requested` flipped to `Durability::Ephemeral`
  (CF-152 — the spec's form; supersedes the ADR-0234 interim ruling made
  only because no `pending` existed);
  `security.permission.escalated` +
  `security.permission.lease.{granted,used,expired,revoked}` declared
  audit-grade (Stage-2 emitters — DF-S1.23-1).
- **Dispatcher Ask path**: `decided{ask, permission_id, requested_at}` →
  durable `pending` → ephemeral `requested` → Stage-1 terminal
  `refused{ask_required}` + `tool.rejected` — one `permission_id`
  threading the trail; no execution. `action.tool.proposed` now mints
  *before* the arg-map eval so a resolve-stage refusal closes the scope it
  opens (repairs a latent `ScopeNotOpen` bug the acceptance test
  surfaced).
- **Projections**: `checkpoint` view, recovery `pending_permissions`, and
  `hh-control::stop::pending_permissions` all fold the durable `pending`
  rows — a pending resolves on a *final* `decided{allow|deny}` (a
  `decision = ask` row opens, never resolves) or when every attached
  `effect_id` terminated (`cancelled`); coalesced pendings merge on
  `effect_ids[]`. Telemetry `approval_requests` counts `pending` (I-P5 —
  replay-stable, never ephemeral renderings).
- **Mediation**: `check_mediation` — a pure fold replayed by the property
  tests: `prepared`/`observed` need a preceding `decided{allow}` or Π
  `authorized` for the same `(effect_id, attempt)`; `committed` needs
  `decided{allow}` (I-H7 — one verdict with the append gate).

### Extension trust (R-2.8.5⁰)
- **`hh-registry::extension`** (new module): `ExtensionRecord` +
  `ExtensionTrustRecord` (authority/attestation/claim/grant/provenance as
  separate legs), `DeclaredSource` closed sum (`directory_scan`,
  `marketplace`, `registry`, `git`, `archive`, `mcp_endpoint`,
  `instruction_files`), `SourceLocator`/`ExtensionRef` with credential-free
  URI validation, `TextHygieneReport` (advisory — bidi/invisible/tag
  codepoints flagged, bytes preserved). `default_text_authority`
  delegates the origin half to `hh_provenance::default_text_authority`
  (one minting table, CC1); `validate_extension_record` refuses over- and
  under-minted `text_authority` (L1 `LocationElevation`).
- **`Assembly.extensions{sources, refs, merge_policy}`**: declared-source
  coverage enforced, `exact_only` refuses duplicate `(name, kind)` refs,
  `resolve_extensions` pins each ref through `RegistryStore::resolve`
  (resolved locator + `fetched_at` + `content`; no surviving `selector`),
  `seal`/`check_completeness` refuse unpinned refs with
  `HirError::UnpinnedInSealedForm` (L4).
- **Event classes**: `security.extension.{resolved, quarantined, sealed,
  loaded, drift, install_requested, install_completed, revoked}` declared
  audit-grade/provenance-mandatory (Stage-4 emitters — DF-S1.23-2).

Closed: none — no `OPEN` row's unblocking condition names this ticket.

## Decisions
**ADR-0259** — `security.permission.requested` fully ephemeral (supersedes
the ADR-0234 interim ruling); the C0 owed-decision trail
(`decided{ask} → pending → requested → refused/cancelled`, one
`permission_id`); `pending` folds resolve on final verdicts + terminated
effects only; `decided{ask}` carries `permission_id`/`requested_at`;
exact-hash run leases; mediation as a replayable fold (`authorized` gating
deferred to S2.6); extension records in `hh-registry` with the single
`default_text_authority` minting table; `Assembly.extensions` +
resolve-time pinning; `proposed` mints before arg-map eval (latent
scope-chain fix).
